column1: # Private pre-push host table for omnimarket (OMN-17232).
# THIS FILE IS AUTHORITY FOR HOST IDENTITY. It holds every lab row that used to
# ship in omnimarket scripts/hooks/prepush_hosts.tsv and in the placement overlay
# config/lab/prepush_hosts.omnimarket.overlay.tsv (retired). A deployment's hosts,
# addresses, logins, paths, slots and tiers are deployment facts supplied by
# whoever runs the system, so they live here and not in the shipped repository;
# the shipped file keeps the column schema and one disabled localhost row.
# The hook reads this file through the workspace-config resolver:
# ${ONEX_WORKSPACE_CONFIG_ROOT:-$registry_root/../ops_tooling_pkg}/config/onex/overlays/prepush_hosts/prepush_hosts.omnimarket.tsv
# and appends its rows to the shipped table's. When the root is a git checkout the
# hook reads the COMMITTED copy (`git show HEAD:`) and refuses if the working tree
# differs, so an uncommitted row cannot self-designate a machine as an authorizing
# gate host. The remote leg ships the verified rows to the target host beside the
# bundle, so the conftest guard there reads the same table.
# The column schema, the meaning of each column and the procedure for adding a
# host are documented in the header of omnimarket scripts/hooks/prepush_hosts.tsv.
# Adding, moving or resizing a host is an edit to THIS file, never to that one.
#label

column15: lab-host-d Mac Studio; the host this repo's pre-OMN-17435 hook designated by literal hostname, so it is authorizing by continuity, not by a new promotion. uv 0.11.32 (read 2026-09-01). heavy_local=prefer_remote for the same reason omnibase_infra's h906 row carries it (OMN-17392, operator directive 2026-08-31 verbatim "<removed>") and because THIS ticket exists: measured 2026-09-01T01:0xZ at 78.24/24 = 3.26x with swap 29131/29696 MB while two omnimarket lanes queued, and re-read at 43.63/24 = 1.82x while this row was written. It stays authorizing and stays a placement target for every other host. KNOWN LIMITATION, verified not assumed: from h904, an ssh to this row's target returns "Permission denied (publickey,password,keyboard-interactive)" -- so when the PUSHER is another lab host this row probes `unreachable` and is skipped. That is the fail-closed skip, not a defect this port introduces (omnibase_infra's identical row has the same property); it means lab-host-d is in practice a local-identity row plus a target for nothing, until that key is present

lab-host-a Linux host, 32 cores, the only non-macOS row. PROVEN FOR OMNIMARKET 2026-09-01 over the real transport: uv 0.11.5, Python 3.12.3, `uv sync --all-extras` rc=0 in 11s from this repo's own lock, `pytest tests/ --collect-only --ignore=tests/integration` rc=0 with 17,722 tests collected in 35.55s, and `pytest tests/scripts tests/golden_chains tests/ci tests/gates` 600 passed / 6 skipped rc=0 in 38.45s under the remote wrapper's PATH. The collected count is 25 BELOW the macOS rows' 17,747 -- a platform-conditional collection difference, recorded here because a table that claims "same tree, same tests everywhere" would be false; it is not a failure and no test errored. Probed under an actively HELD heavy slot (omn17319-prepush2, omnibase_core) at load1 6.11/32 = 0.19x; the slot was NOT taken and NOT preempted by this proof. Separately proven by first-hand read of ~/push-lanes/queue-runner.log rather than by analogy: 12 completed omnimarket lanes between 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-30, 8 rc=0 (OMN-16663, OMN-16690, OMN-16924, OMN-16944, OMN-16833, OMN-17202 x2, OMN-17018) and 4 rc=1 -- the rc=1 lanes are branch test failures, and this table does NOT claim they were host-coupled. slot_mode=queue: this row runs the separate ~/push-lanes/QUEUE serializer (OMN-16968), a different concurrency mechanism from the lockdir rows, so slots stays 1. Before this file existed, that queue was reachable for omnimarket ONLY by a human hand-routing a lane into ~/push-lanes/lanes/<lane>.env + QUEUE OMN-17485: heavy_local flipped allowed -> prefer_remote and placement_tier set last_resort -- this host is the dev runtime lane's live evidence surface AND an interactive collaborator workspace, and on 2026-09-01 its gate-runner slot ran heavy suites back-to-back 08:31Z-12:02Z while a collaborator's own governed full core suite (44464 tests, 2h58m) ran host-side concurrently. A heavy escalation ORIGINATING here now attempts lab placement first (same OMN-17392 semantics as h906), and as a TARGET this row is taken only when no default-tier host is fit. OMN-17752: slots=1 -> 3 for THIS ROW ONLY, carrying the omnibase_infra OMN-17743 measurement across the vendored table. h906/h903/h904 stay slots=1 here, deliberately: test_the_shipped_slots_column_is_pinned's objection -- that this repo's escalation target is all ~17,700 tests of tests/ and two concurrent runs of that on a 10-core M4 was never measured -- is about h904's 10 cores and it still stands. It does not carry to a 32-core, 92 GiB host. The per-leg CPU cost is repo-independent: prepush_remote_xdist_workers = min(cores, PREPUSH_REMOTE_XDIST_WORKER_CAP) = min(32,4) = 4 workers whatever the suite is, so the 5.0-cores-per-leg budget holds for an omnimarket leg exactly as for a core leg, and the baseline it is added to was measured ON THIS HOST 2026-09-03T10:57Z-11:03Z: 147 containers totalling 2.46 cores under docker stats --no-stream (the 90-runner CI fleet only 0.11 of it, idle since OMN-16688), /proc/loadavg mean load1 7.03/32 = 0.22x, ~6.0 cores of non-prepush baseline once the one in-flight leg (98.7%) is subtracted. Full complement at 3 slots = 21.0 load1 = 0.66x against the 1.0x threshold, leaving 11 cores for the five live runtime lanes and the interactive collaborator workspace OMN-17485 protects. Residual stated not hidden: peak RSS of an OMNIMARKET leg on this host is unmeasured (the 674 MiB figure is an omnibase_core pytest), which is bounded rather than assumed -- prepush_probe_mem_ok re-checks PREPUSH_MIN_FREE_MEM_MB=4096 per slot at pick time against ~57 GiB available, so three legs would each have to hold ~17 GiB before admission bites. Unlike omnibase_infra and omnibase_core, this repo's vendored prepush_dispatch.sh ALREADY carries the OMN-17606 slot-probe fix (#2276 merged 2026-09-03T00:40:19Z), so slots 2 and 3 declared here are reachable today -- proven live at 11:02:45Z against this very copy: slot1=BUSY(queue=0 heavy_pids=1 lock=1 held=1) slot2=FREE slot3=FREE.

column15: lab-host-a gate-runner CONTAINER hostname; no sshd (OMN-16446) so identity-only. This row is what the pre-OMN-17435 PREPUSH_201_GATE_RUNNER_HOSTNAME env var used to name. Keeping it as a ROW is the point: the container reports gate-runner-a while the host reports host-49-example, so before this table a push on lab-host-a needed that variable exported to pass the identity guard, and the variable had to survive a process and ssh boundary to do it OMN-17485: carries heavy_local=prefer_remote because the container IS the local host of every in-container push and those escalations should look off-box first; with no ssh reachability from inside the container every probe refusal is structural, so the OMN-17392 ladder falls through to the same in-container slot path it used before -- strictly no wider.

MacBook, 12 cores. PROVEN FOR OMNIMARKET 2026-09-01 over the real transport, not carried over from omnibase_infra's row: uv 0.12.7, Python 3.12.11, `uv sync --all-extras` rc=0 in 6s, `pytest tests/ --collect-only --ignore=tests/integration` rc=0 with 17,747 tests collected in 31.18s, `pytest tests/scripts` 73 passed / 4 skipped rc=0, `pytest tests/golden_chains tests/ci tests/gates` 527 passed / 2 skipped rc=0 in 39.34s. load1 5.02/12 = 0.418x at proof time. Promoted straight to authorizing on the same reasoning omnibase_infra used for h904/h903: a shadow row can never record a heavy verdict, because the transplanted guard refuses a full-suite target on any host outside the authorizing set, so a shadow day proves nothing and the promotion is proven by real dispatch instead. DISK CAVEAT (OMN-17420, unlanded upstream): 68 GiB free of 926 GiB = 93% used at proof time. The picker has NO min-free-disk fitness dimension yet -- an ENOSPC mid-suite here returns a red indistinguishable from a real failure. That precondition belongs in prepush_dispatch.sh upstream; adding it here would fork the byte-identical copy REPOS_DENIED=omnimarket, and the reason is MEASURED, not precautionary. A real dispatch of this repo's full suite to this host on 2026-09-01 ran 17,883 tests in 13m58s and returned 12 HOST-COUPLED failures -- a FALSE RED, which prepush_dispatch.sh correctly treats as a genuine red and which therefore HARD-BLOCKS the push. Single root cause, not twelve: $registry_root is not propagated across the ssh boundary, and two call sites silently default to `Path.home()/'Code'/'registry_root'` (handler_post_merge_sync.py's EVIDENCE_BASE_DIR and market_skill_baseline _smoke_aislop_sweep's env). That path EXISTS on the lab Macs and is TCC-denied to sshd, so 11 node_post_merge_knowledge_sync_orchestrator tests raise PermissionError on mkdir and test_market_skill_smokes gets non-JSON from a sweep that could not read the workspace. All 12 pass locally. Lifting this denial is a ONE-FIELD change once that coupling is fixed -- the capacity itself is already proven above. Shipping it undenied today would make this gate strictly WORSE than the status quo it replaces: a guaranteed false red is worse than an honest refusal. The row KEEPS mode=authorizing on purpose: the denial is about THIS REPO's workspace coupling, not about the host's standing -- de-designating it would also stop it authorizing anything else and would delete an identity that is genuinely valid. This is the same column, and the same lift-when-proven path, that OMN-16989 used for h907 in omnibase_infra.

OMN-17232: HP ProLiant DL560 Gen8, 80 hardware threads and 377 GiB of memory (free -g on the host read total 377, available 371, 2026-10-30; the lane census figure of 125 GB was wrong). slots=12 holds the memory per concurrent lane at parity with h907: h907 runs 3 slots on 94 GB (31 GB per slot, lab_run_hosts), and 377 GiB over 12 slots is 31.4 GiB per slot (floor of 377 / 31.3); memory and not the 80 threads is the binding resource, so the thread count does not raise it. placement_tier=default ranks this host ahead of h907 (last_resort) for every job it can run. repos_denied is empty: the host has no AVX2 (Ivy Bridge) but no pre-push suite in this repository imports an AVX2 wheel (OMN-17232 census). No remote-leg proof of this repository's suite on this host is recorded in this row; the host is registered unavailable for lab placement, and a probe that cannot reach a host SKIPS it, so the row costs a push nothing until the host answers.
